answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered model agency booking file with model agencies standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the zephyr up to the light, weigh the falcon of the attack, and keep the anchor of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
